svg.title: Hardman and Jacobs Undergraduate Learning Center — Floor 2
svg.desc: Editable vector redraw of the supplied second-floor evacuation-plan photograph. Room numbers, corridors, stairs, elevator, and open-to-below areas are retained. Geometry is schematic and not a measured architectural survey. Poster frame, reflections, evacuation arrows, and the source-location pin are omitted. Building code HA, property number 323. Restyled to match the supplied gray campus-map reference: light rooms, darker corridors, bold perimeter, dashed voids, stair symbols, green stair-exit labels, legend, and compass. Staff-access status is not assigned to any room because the source does not identify it.
